_comment: Hand-kept half of /news, rendered with news/sources.json by scripts/build-news.mjs. `entries` holds what nothing reports on its own: site launches and redesigns, art. `sites` lists the site repos whose finished weeks of merged pull requests become entries automatically (scripts/fetch-news.mjs), each from the week after its `since` (launch) date; only pull requests opened by an account in `siteAuthors` are read. `outsideAuthors` are the accounts whose pull requests merged, and issues fixed, in repos outside the two orgs become Contribution entries; `outsideSkip` lists indexes that only list this site's own work. `hide` removes any entry by id. `skip` hides a repo's releases. `projects` names a repo on the page (the repo name otherwise). `overrides` replaces the line taken from a release's notes, keyed owner/repo@tag. Lines are short and plain, no first person; the build drops or fails on a tool or agent name in a title or summary, as /ai does.

overrides.mdws-org/emoji-fix@v1.3.1: First release: draws emoji with a bundled Noto Color Emoji font on Macs where Brave and other Chromium browsers draw them as blank space.
overrides.mdws-org/emoji-fix@v1.4.0: Adds a per-site off switch, and stops running inside the challenge frames sites use to screen visitors.
overrides.mdws-org/freewallet-desktop@v2.1.1: First release of the fork, for Apple Silicon, with an in-app update check.
overrides.mdws-org/nnw-prayer-book@v1.0.0: First release: EB Garamond, parchment by day and vigil by night, rubric-red links and a red drop cap.
overrides.mdws-org/nnw-prayer-book@v1.1.0: First release, with a 42em column and larger Mac text sizes: EB Garamond, parchment by day and vigil by night, rubric-red links.
overrides.mdws-org/nnw-prayer-book@v1.2.0: Hacker News link lines are set ragged instead of justified, and hover styles apply only where a pointer can hover.
overrides.mdws-org/nnw-prayer-book@v1.3.0: Hides the dark-mode switches some sites leave in Reader View, and keeps small icons at text size.
overrides.mdws-org/pepecoin@v1.1.0-mdws.1: First release of the fork: Pepecoin-Qt 1.1.0 for macOS on Apple Silicon, signed with a Developer ID.
overrides.mdws-org/squint@v0.8.3: Signed and notarized by Apple, PDFs and the Finder menu reach Shrink, rows update as each file finishes, and the app gets its own icon.
overrides.mdws-org/squint@v0.9.7: Remove Location Data handles GeoTIFFs, raw previews and Blackmagic DNGs, and the window comes back after it is closed.
overrides.mdws-org/wowlet@v5.0.3-mdws.1: First release of the fork: wowlet 5.0.3 for macOS on Apple Silicon, signed with a Developer ID.
